findings.what: splitRootCause treats a marker quoted in prose ('Symptom:', "Cause:") as a split point: U3's own A3 I1 and I2 show cause text under Symptom and Fix direction, and the quoted words are lost.
findings.why: The marker pattern /(Symptom|Cause|Fix direction)(\s*\([^)]*\))?:/g has no anchor, so it matches every occurrence anywhere in the text, including quoted mentions. With the new join-in-order behaviour, each quoted mention moves the text that follows it into the field it names. The real trail shows it on this node's own round, docs/trace/ui/U3/findings/A3.md:13, the only round whose root_cause quotes a marker. In I1, the Cause field stops at "long-content.html:33 says 'Where a sentence comes before the \"". The rest of the cause (the long-content quote, the retry-ladder README critique, the p0-reconciled note) is appended to Symptom through the quoted "Symptom:" and 'Symptom:'. In I2, the quoted 'Fix direction:' makes the Fix direction field open with "'. Real rounds also write qualified forms. docs/trace/ui/U3/findings/A2.md:14 has '". The quoted 'Symptom (security S1, P2, verdict PASS):' sends the middle of the cause ("An unmatched qualified marker is not a split point ... HONEST-1 forbids naming a gap ('no") to Symptom, and the quoted 'Cause:' and "Cause:" words disappear from the text. That is R1's symptom from A3: cause text under the Symptom label, on a real trail, on a page that labels the text 'recorded' (DATA-2). The function's own doc comment (:232) says 'Every character lands in a field', which is false here. The tests can't see it. Every new fixture text uses markers only at sentence starts, and expectEveryWord's MARKER_NAME (loop-4.test.ts:170) strips every marker name wherever it appears, so a dropped quoted marker word passes. The A3/I1 fix direction asked that every character of the recorded root_cause end up in some field. Route: first a red test on a fixture root_cause that quotes a marker inside a sentence (for example "Cause: it matches only 'Symptom:' and 'Cause:'. Fix direction: F1."), then the compiler fix. This is narrower than A3's R1 but the same defect on the node's own trail, so it blocks by the same bar.
